The core portraits use a revision of a generated candidate. front-room-00 and courtyard-13 use generated room references. The decoration paintings use generated design references. Each holiday decoration is a masked edit of a room state, cut out by its difference from that state. The two rat sheets use generated identity references from the references list. The thief rat sheet uses a cell trim, without painted pixels. This record preserves the source and review evidence of the current assets. This record does not give legal clearance.
